review_notes: Vágar is the Faroe Islands' principal commercial airport: operator CEO reports 461,064 passengers and more than 8,400 tonnes freight in 2025, including FarCargo seafood exports. Actual 2025 history is not modeled future demand.
UK CAA 2025 non-UK reporting airport tables: Guernsey 692,139 terminal/transit passengers and 346 tonnes handled air freight. Positive freight does not prove widebody all-cargo operating suitability.

Gibraltar Airport official 2025 annual report: 437,172 passengers and 106,940 kilograms combined cargo/mail/courier. This combined small freight/mail total does not imply dedicated freighter flights. Shared military/civil runway needs distinct access arrangements.

Air Greenland 2026 route schedule lists passenger connections via Kangerlussuaq; airline publishes a dedicated Kangerlussuaq cargo terminal. Post-Nuuk hub changes affect traffic levels; no unrestricted daily intercontinental airline access inferred.

Narsarsuaq operated commercial fixed-wing passengers prior to 16 Apr 2026; Air Greenland confirms last scheduled fixed-wing service 15 Apr 2026 and transition to HELIPORT from 16 Apr. Cargo operator still lists an Narsarsuaq handling point. This is HISTORIC FIXED-WING evidence + current heliport handling, not permission for fixed-wing airline routes now.

Nuuk is the active main Greenland international passenger hub in 2026; Air Greenland publishes a separate Nuuk freight terminal and cargo acceptance hours. Airline schedules and cargo counter times vary.

Air Greenland documents scheduled passenger/settlement flights to Pituffik Space Base, with compulsory transit/residence permission even for transfer passengers. Airline also publishes cargo services for Pituffik/Thule. Military base is NOT an unrestricted civilian airport.

Qaqortoq new 1,500m regional airport opened on 16 Apr 2026 with scheduled Air Greenland Dash-8 flights via Nuuk. Operator sells express cargo from Qaqortoq; this documents shipments, not a cargo terminal or unrestricted freighters. Initial Danish regulator approval was CONDITIONAL (operator/flight-rate limitations); check subsequent updates before route activation.
UK CAA 2025 non-UK reporting figures: Isle of Man 617,085 terminal/transit passengers and 12 tonnes of air freight. Small freight is not proof of dedicated freighter operations.
UK CAA 2025 non-UK reporting figures: Jersey 1,453,675 terminal/transit passengers and 477 tonnes air freight. Handling rights, customs, airport hours and payload must be separately evaluated.
